description:
I’m Glory Abayomi, a Remote Sensing and GIS student My interests are satellite radar, ground deformation and natural hazards, and my skills are InSAR processing, GIS and geospatial Python.

For “Dancing with the SARs” I’m building a web app that uses NISAR radar to monitor unstable slopes above the Lhende Khola in Rasuwa, Nepal, where an avalanche caused a flood in August 2026.

I’d welcome teammates with skills in web design and front-end development, science communication or video.
